sources.title: La Table du Castellet — official restaurant page
sources.claim: La Table du Castellet — 3001 Route des Hauts du Camp 83330 Le Castellet. Awarded three Michelin stars since March 2024. Lunch Friday to Sunday, dinner Wednesday to Saturday.

sources.title: Hôtel & Spa du Castellet — official site
sources.claim: 43 rooms and suites; 700 m² spa; Le Castellet Golf Club; two restaurants: La Table du Castellet and Le San Felice; Relais & Châteaux property.

sources.title: PACA Tourism — Hôtel & Spa du Castellet listing
sources.claim: 5-star property with 43 rooms and suites; Spa du Castellet (voted 'Best Luxury Spa in Europe' in 2019); Open February 28 - December 1, 2026.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hotels near Circuit Paul Ricard
sources.claim: Hotel et Spa du Castellet — Distance: 0.5 miles (0.8 km), Rating 4.6/5. Grand Prix Hôtel & Restaurant 3* — Distance: 0.8 miles (1.3 km), Rating 4.3/5.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hôtel & Spa du Castellet review
sources.claim: Ranked #1 of 2 hotels in Le Castellet, 4.5 of 5. Prices on Tripadvisor show $309 (Was $352) for nightly room rates.

sources.title: momondo — Hôtel & Spa du Castellet
sources.claim: Rating of 9.2 Excellent with 262 reviews and rooms range from $347 to $1,577. Some guests wished that breakfast was included.

sources.title: Grand Prix Hôtel — access page
sources.claim: 3100 Route des Hauts du Camp, 83330 Le Castellet, France. The hotel is located directly on the Circuit Paul Ricard.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Grand Prix Hotel review
sources.claim: Rating & Class: 4.3 out of 5 stars (596 reviews); 3-star hotel. Number of Rooms: 117. Typical Price Range: $88–$241 per night. Address: 3100 route des Hauts du Camp.

sources.title: KAYAK — Grand Prix Hotel
sources.claim: Grand Prix Hotel & Restaurant from $143. Hotel And Spa Du Castellet is 0.45 miles away from Grand Prix Hôtel.

sources.title: PACA Tourism — La Table du Castellet
sources.claim: La Table du Castellet, gastronomic restaurant at Hôtel & Spa du Castellet, Le Castellet. Executive Chef Fabien Ferré, three Michelin stars.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — La Table du Castellet
sources.claim: La Table du Castellet — Le Castellet — a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant.

sources.title: France-Voyage — Le Castellet village
sources.claim: Le Castellet, perched medieval village in the Var. The hilltop village is distinct from the Camp du Castellet plateau hosting the circuit and Hôtel & Spa du Castellet.
